descriptions.w3d_s20_forward_position_800e705c: Appears to call a helper and, when a field is set, call virtual method 17 of the owner with a local vector, then copy that vector to the output.
descriptions.w3d_s20_reset_vectors_800e67d0: Appears to call a base helper, copy one field to another, clear a flag and set two vectors to a constant value.
descriptions.w3d_s20_release_held_pair_800f339c: Appears to release two held objects through virtual method 4, clear related fields and reset a handle with a helper call when it is valid.
descriptions.w3d_s20_construct_cleared_800efe34: Appears to run a base constructor, set a vtable pointer and clear a block of fields, returning the object.
descriptions.w3d_s20_set_normalized_direction_800ecfe: Appears to copy a vector into a direction field and scale it to a constant length using its square root length.
